ideas.pitch: A real-time log ingestion and governance tool designed to halt self-erasing database scripts by detecting unauthorized SQL execution patterns and isolating memory dumps during a simulated server wipe.
ideas.title: EpochGuard: Automated Forensic Telemetry Recovery
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the core narrative of escaping a self-wiping server by combining open-source telemetry governance with live anomaly detection, echoing proven hackathon architectures.

ideas.pitch: An investigative dashboard that ingests recovered workstation logs and uses graph intelligence to map relationships and data access pathways between Dr. Meera Kapoor and potential insider threats.
ideas.title: BitoTrace: Graph-Based AML & Insider Threat Investigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence and automated risk detection patterns that consistently win high-stakes investigation and compliance hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic routing system that rapidly indexes, classifies, and queries thousands of fragmented text files and half-erased server log fragments against a dynamic exemplar index.
ideas.title: DarwinLog: Semantic Router for Corrupted Evidence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Implements an advanced semantic routing approach that won top prizes for efficiency, allowing judges to query chaotic unstructured log data instantly during a live demo.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight Python utility that scans a recovered machine's state, instantly generating an executive security summary, timeline of unauthorized database orders, and a complete forensic report of the breach.
ideas.title: Reportr-Forensic: Automated Terminal Summarization
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact formula of Microsoft Global Intern Hackathon winners by delivering automated repo and system summarization with immediate utility for incident responders.

ideas.pitch: A BPMN-orchestrated agentic workflow that guides the recovery squad through triage steps, validating human decisions and safely rolling back unauthorized database migrations before the wipe bar hits 100%.
ideas.title: AgentBPMN: Human-in-the-Loop Server Recovery Orchestrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Capitalizes on structured agent governance and human-in-the-loop validation patterns that scored podium finishes in recent agentic hackathons.
